Cubic crystals are Δn=0. The rest is analog-driven: I-4 lattices that match known ~0.1 compounds, and the Pm Li–Mg–Ga–Se family that sits at ~0.1 in training.

**c082 Al₄Hg₂Se₈** (I-4): cell almost identical to Ga₄Hg₂Se₈ (Δn=0.105); Al vs Ga lowers it slightly → **~0.100**.

**c098 / c095 Li₂MgGa₂Se₅** (Pm, b≈3.88 Å, c≈10 Å): same structure type as Li₃Mg₂GaSe₅ (0.042–0.118) and close to LiMgGaSe₃ (0.096–0.109). Ga-richer than the Li₃ analog → **~0.10–0.11**. c098 matches a≈6.63 of the 0.109/0.118 cells; c095 matches V/atom of LiMgGaSe₃.

**c071 Al₂Cu₂Ge₂Se₈** (I-4): lattice twin of Ga₂Cu₂Ge₂Se₈ (0.123); also In₂Cu₂Ge₂Se₈ (0.094), Al₂Cu₂Sn₂Se₈ (0.081) → **~0.11**.

**c056 In₂Ag₂Ge₂Se₈** (I-4): In₂Cu₂Ge₂Se₈ (0.094) and In₂Ag₂Sn₂Se₈ (0.080) → **~0.087**.

Final: c082, c098, c095, c071, c056

    masses = props[:,1]
    f['density'] = masses.sum()/(vol*0.6022)  # g/cm3 approx
    
    # anion/cation
    n_anion = sum(counts[e] for e in elems if e in ANIONS)

    f['frac_lone'] = sum(counts[e] for e in elems if e in LONEPAIR)/n
    f['frac_polar_an'] = sum(counts[e] for e in elems if e in POLAR_ANION)/n

def magpie_stats(comp):
    els=[]; fracs=[]
    for e, amt in comp.get_el_amt_dict().items():
        els.append(Element(e)); fracs.append(amt)
    fracs=np.array(fracs); fracs=fracs/fracs.sum()
    out={}
    for p in ['Z','X','atomic_radius','mendeleev_no','group','row','atomic_mass']:
        vals=[]
        for el in els:
            try:
                v = el.Z if p=='Z' else getattr(el,p)
                v=0 if v is None else float(v)
            except: v=0
            vals.append(v)
        vals=np.array(vals)
        out[f'{p}_mean']=float((fracs*vals).sum())
        out[f'{p}_std']=float(np.sqrt((fracs*(vals-out[f'{p}_mean'])**2).sum()))
        out[f'{p}_min']=float(vals.min()); out[f'{p}_max']=float(vals.max())
    return out

def feats(st):
    f=magpie_stats(st.composition)
    lat=st.lattice
    abc=np.sort(lat.abc); ang=np.sort(lat.angles)
    f['a'],f['b'],f['c']=abc
    f['alpha'],f['beta'],f['gamma']=ang
    f['aniso']=abc[2]/abc[0]
    f['vol_pa']=st.volume/len(st)
    f['density']=float(st.density)
    f['n']=len(st)
    f['n_el']=len(st.composition.elements)
    f['ca']=lat.c/lat.a

    spg=spglib.get_spacegroup(cell, symprec=0.2)
